name: @missdeer/gemini-mcp-rs

tools.name: gemini
tools.description: Invokes the Gemini CLI to execute AI-driven tasks, returning structured JSON events and a session identifier for conversation continuity.

PROMPT.description: Instruction for the task to send to gemini

SESSION_ID.description: Resume the specified session of the gemini. If not provided or empty, starts a new session

model.description:
The model to use for the gemini session. If not specified, uses GEMINI_FORCE_MODEL
environment variable or the Gemini CLI default

return_all_messages.description: Return all messages (e.g. reasoning, tool calls, etc.) from the gemini session. Set to `False` by default, only the agent's final reply message is returned

sandbox.description: Run in sandbox mode. Defaults to `False`

timeout_secs.description:
Timeout in seconds for gemini execution (1-3600). If not specified, uses GEMINI_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT
environment variable or falls back to 600 seconds (10 minutes).

instructions: This server provides a gemini tool for AI-driven tasks. Use the gemini tool to execute tasks via the Gemini CLI.
